description: 2026-07-28 adversarial review of the behavioral A/B gate found: (1) scoring circularity — score.py:36 gates irrelevant_rejection on retrieved-union-trusted so honest consider-and-reject behavior scores 0.0 (raw baseline responses show correct trust discrimination), expected live_verification and answer_properties labels are injected verbatim into every prompt (runner.py:74-83), the treatment's perfect sweep is guaranteed by fixture construction (tests/scorers/test_behavioral.py:101-106), and safety dimensions fire only on model self-confession; (2) harness launch blockers — subprocess.TimeoutExpired and CalledProcessError are uncaught (runner.py:228) so one slow run discards concurrent results and blinds the isolation hash chain, the Claude subprocess has no pinned cwd (silent Read denial under dontAsk gets scored), Claude context_tokens reads usage.input_tokens only (cache fields uncounted, voiding the context gate), and the exact production Claude command (--tools Read --permission-mode dontAsk --json-schema) has never been exercised; (3) provenance fragility — the scorer and audit hard-require purgeable /tmp/memory-behavioral-raw; (4) disclosures — orphan r0 pilot session read live user config before isolation flags were final, a full first execution pass (~14:37-14:41) was discarded and never disclosed, the sk-fixture canary is committed in three repo files and was read by a treatment-arm session, and the item-level criterion 'Codex injected-token reduction >=30%' is not implemented by score.py (actual reduction 9.3%). Capability gaps recorded here because the wrapper CLI has no update/doctor subcommand and no standalone todo-db >=0.3 CLI is installed: phase 3 verify rung 1 references $MEMORY_TOOLING_ROOT/reports/ab-results.json which cannot exist (canonical report is repo-root reports/ab-results.json); phase 3 only_modify omits memory_tooling/** although its w4 requires treatment corrections there; phase 4's ladder requires python -m memory_tooling.rollout while its only_modify excludes memory_tooling/** and evaluation_runs/**. Phase 3 w2 (72 Claude sessions) must not launch until this item completes, and must launch from a plain external terminal: any live Claude session writes ~/.claude/projects and trips the runner's before/after isolation hash.
